title: 上网用途｜官方数据改编
prompt: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. The bar chart compares four selected internet activities among men and women aged 16 and over in Great Britain in 2013. Each percentage refers to adults of that sex. The chart has been adapted from published ONS data for this practice exercise. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

data.title: 男女上网用途｜ONS数据改编，非考场原图
